description: The organization has not implemented adequate protection for data in transit. This signal indicates the absence of encryption or other security measures to protect data during transmission.
applicability: Organizations pursuing SOC 2 certification, Service organizations transmitting sensitive data

metadata.detection_notes: Detection involves reviewing network configurations, checking for TLS/SSL implementation, and verifying encryption is used for sensitive data transmission.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - CC6 Logical and Physical Access Controls
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination
